text: In one of those homes, a mother gave birth to a son. And she was terrified.
Then Allah inspired her: "When you fear for him, cast him into the river. And do not fear, and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you, and make him one of the messengers."
So she placed her baby in a basket, and gave him to the river.
The river carried him... straight to the palace of Pharaoh. And the family of Pharaoh picked him up.
Pharaoh's wife looked at the baby and said: "A comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him."
Back at home, his mother's heart became empty. His sister followed the basket from a distance.
And the baby refused every nurse in the palace... until his sister said: shall I show you a family who will take care of him?
And so Allah returned him to his mother, "so that she would know that the promise of Allah is true."
The child Pharaoh feared most... grew up in Pharaoh's own house.
